name: PublicNode Ethereum JSON-RPC
tier_rationale: Allnodes Inc., an established node-hosting company with published terms of service (A8 trusted); P205 cond 7 and P212 cond 5 'PublicNode (Allnodes) trusted'.

reliability.justification: Public Ethereum node answering eth_call against current chain state: answers are as reliable as the node's sync state, and any anomalous answer is ERROR (could not verify), never 'not sanctioned' (P205 cond 4).

ethereum_rpc.title: PublicNode Ethereum JSON-RPC (eth_call to the Chainalysis sanctions oracle, balances)

terms.quote: Blockscout keyless and PublicNode RPC 'open' (free public APIs, terms recorded, as in P205 and P211)

ethereum_rpc.notes: Quote: binding council text (P212 cond 5; P205 cond 7: oracle and stablecoin calls 'open'). Research C0484/C0493 terms 'PublicNode (Allnodes) ToS.' (verified_live 200). The PublicNode Terms of Service (checked 2026-11-26) allow automated access to the endpoints 'for development and production purposes' without prior authorization, under automatic Usage Limits (HTTP 429 when exceeded); chain data may be used in own applications but not resold as an RPC or data service. JSON-RPC POST eth_call: the Chainalysis sanctions oracle isSanctioned (selector 0xdf592f7d), USDT isBlackListed and USDC isBlacklisted reads, balances and code (P205 cond 2, P212 cond 2). embeds chainalysis: oracle answers are Chainalysis-curated sanctions data, the same upstream as the Chainalysis REST check. Used by crypto_sanctions (onchain) and evm_explorers.

notes: Shared seed for batches p1-G09-1, p2-G09-2 (P205, P212): batches only extend it (publicnode__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). Keyless: V3LUM_ETH_RPC (P205) is the eth_rpc setting for an alternative RPC URL, not a key of this provider; another RPC host needs its own provider entry. No published Usage Limits figures: no quota block (429 = RATE_LIMITED). ttl 1 h (crypto class); JSON-RPC POSTs are not cached unless a module asks. No error markers yet: the owning batch adds the JSON-RPC error.code marker (ERROR, could not verify) with a trimmed real fixture (P205 cond 4).
